hero_text: Personalised makeup for everyday looks, special occasions, photoshoots and weddings – subtle or statement, always tailored to you.
intro_title: Not to hide you. To highlight what is already beautiful.
intro_text: LUMÉA is a demo website concept for a makeup artist. The final site can be built around your name, portfolio, prices, social links and real appointment booking.
hair_text: Fresh, natural and long-lasting makeup for everyday life, business looks or a special day.
skin_text: Elegant or expressive makeup for weddings, dinners, photoshoots, celebrations and every moment when you want to glow.
makeup_text: One-to-one makeup lessons to help you get the most from your features and the products you already own.
prices_note: All shown prices are demo data only. A real site can show the artist's own prices and service durations.
studio_text: Great makeup is not a mask. It keeps your individuality while highlighting the details that make you feel truly yourself.
point1p: We choose the makeup direction together based on the occasion, outfit and your vision.
point2p: Hygienic tools, carefully selected textures and a long-lasting, camera-ready finish.
point3p: Whether it is a wedding or an event, the goal is a relaxed preparation that leaves you feeling confident.
look_quote: Makeup works best when people do not notice the makeup – they notice you glowing.
booking_title: Let's find the right time for you.
booking_text: This is a demo form. A final website can connect to email, WhatsApp or a real online booking system.
form_placeholder: Tell us briefly what makeup look you would like...
form_demo: Demo form – no real booking is sent.
form_success: Demo: the appointment request would be sent here.
faq1q: How should I choose my makeup look?
faq1a: We choose the right direction together based on the occasion, outfit, lighting and your personal style.
faq2q: Is there a bridal trial before the wedding?
faq2a: Yes. A final service can include a dedicated trial so every detail feels right before the big day.
faq3a: The demo shows a request form, but a real online booking system can be integrated for a client.
web_title: Would you like a modern website for your makeup business?
web_text: This LUMÉA website is a demo example. I create similar sites tailored to your own name, services, prices, images and contact details for beauty professionals.
footer_note: Services, prices and contact details are demo data.
